skill.summary: Discover AI capabilities beyond text — images, voice, video, and multimodal interaction.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Multimodal AI Explorer skill.
- Guides users through AI capabilities beyond text, covering images, voice, video, document, and code modalities.
- Explains strengths, limitations, and safe use practices for each modality.
- Helps users choose and plan a low-risk experiment to explore a new AI capability.
- Stresses privacy, consent, and responsible use throughout.
- Purely conceptual—does not process or execute any media or code.
